args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Incident opened to track investigation of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback and flagging the v2.3.1 regression for investigation.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required.
